lines.text: Many learners say: I live here since 2020.
Better: I have lived here since 2020.
Have lived! I have lived here since May.

native.tip: Со словом since нужно “have lived”, а не “live”.
native.caption: Ты тоже говоришь “I live here since 2020.”? 😅 По-русски «живу с 2020» — настоящее время, а в английском нужно “have lived”. Правильно: “I have lived here since 2020.”. Послушай Ама и повтори! Больше практики — в приложении Lexkite.
native.comment: Ответ: “have lived”. Since — это have lived. Бесплатный тест для практики здесь: {link}

en.tip: With since, you need “have lived”, not “live”.
en.caption: Do you also say “I live here since 2020.”? 😅 In Russian we say “zhivu s 2020”, but English needs “have lived”. Correct: “I have lived here since 2020.”. Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
